This editorial illustration features a magazine cover with a yellow and cream circular background. At the top, the large word "TEMPO" is printed in orange. Below it, the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" appears. To the left, text reads "INVESTIGASI: CUCI KAYU ILEGAL PAPUA," and to the right, "ASAL-USUL BAHAR BIN SMITH."

The central headline is "BALENGGANG PETE-PETE" in large black letters. Below this, smaller text reads: "MENGATASI ELEKTABILITAS PRABOWO YANG DIYAKINI MANDEK, SANDIAGA UNO BERKELILING MENJAJAKAN DIRI. TERHAMBAT ANGGARAN CEKAK."

The foreground features two men. On the left, a man with orange-toned skin wears a white long-sleeved shirt and a black songkok. He is depicted from the chest up, leaning forward with open hands. To the right, a man in a blue t-shirt and glasses wears a cluster of green petai pods (stink beans) on his head like hair. He is shown from the waist up, facing right. At the bottom left, a barcode is visible with numbers "9 770126 427302," alongside "00044," "24-30 DESEMBER 2018," "RP 45.000," "WWW.TEMPO.CO," "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN," and "ISSN: 0126 - 4273."
